metadata.article_title: Punishment for false information furnished in application.

article.title: Punishment for false information furnished in application.
article.content: Where any person furnishes information in the application made under section 7, which is false in material particulars, knowing it to be false or omits any material fact, knowing it to be material, such person shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than one lakh rupees, but may extend to one crore rupees.
article.html:
75Punishment for false information furnished in application.

Section 75 · Part II · Chapter VII · page 86 of the Act

Where any person furnishes information in the application made under section 7, which is false in material particulars, knowing it to be false or omits any material fact, knowing it to be material, such person shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than one lakh rupees, but may extend to one crore rupees.
